articles.title: Boeing Secures a $2.81B Contract to Upgrade South Korea's F-15 Fleet
articles.mainIdea: Boeing Secures a $2.81B Contract to Upgrade South Korea's F-15 Fleet
articles.summary: Zacks: Boeing Secures a $2.81B Contract to Upgrade South Korea's F-15 Fleet. BA lands a $2.81B deal to modernize South Korea's F-15K jets, locking in long-term defense work through 2037 and deepening its global military footprint. Related tickers mentioned: EMBJ, LMT, NOC.

articles.title: BAE Systems receives $195 million contract for 30 additional Amphibious Combat Vehicles
articles.mainIdea: BAE Systems receives $195 million contract for 30 additional Amphibious Combat Vehicles
articles.summary: PR Newswire: BAE Systems receives $195 million contract for 30 additional Amphibious Combat Vehicles. BAE Systems (LON: BA) has received a $195 million contract for the production of additional Amphibious Combat Vehicles (ACVs) for the U.S. Marine Corps. This award increases the total number of ACV-30s ordered under that contract to more than 150. Related tickers mentioned: BAESF.

articles.title: Stratasys Begins Qualification of SAF™ PA12 Production-Ready Nylon for Key Industrial Use Cases
articles.mainIdea: Stratasys Begins Qualification of SAF™ PA12 Production-Ready Nylon for Key Industrial Use Cases
articles.summary: Business Wire: Stratasys Begins Qualification of SAF™ PA12 Production-Ready Nylon for Key Industrial Use Cases. MINNETONKA, Minn. & REHOVOT, Israel, February 03, 2026--Stratasys Ltd. (NASDAQ: SSYS) today announced the launch of a qualification program of SAF™ PA12, a production-ready nylon material, designed to help manufacturers apply selective absorption fusion technology across key aerospace and industrial use cases. This program is intended to help manufacturers address modernization and reshoring initiatives by enabling more scalable, qualified additive manufacturing. Related tickers mentioned: NOC, SSYS.
